# Repo Review Prompt

Review this repository for architecture quality and public portfolio readiness.

## Review Areas

- Folder structure clarity and maintainability.
- Dependency isolation between apps and custom services.
- README quality and setup accuracy.
- Presence of public-safety issues (secrets, private docs, large generated files).
- Modularity and code organization quality.

## Constraints

- Treat `apps/docling-serve` and `apps/label-studio` as external applications.
- Avoid recommendations that mix isolated environments.

## Expected Output

- Findings ordered by severity.
- Concrete file-level improvement suggestions.
- Quick wins for better recruiter-friendly presentation.
